goal: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene product from this tower at polymer-grade purity. Find what limits it and propose the change; make the design pass every engineering check. If existing internals limit, replace them with replace_unit and a new rating (vendor to confirm). Column flow amounts are written at today's throughput; the solver scales them.
